name: godot-gamestudio
description: A supervised multi-agent studio loop for planning, building, reviewing, and verifying Godot games.
author: Koenraad
skillInstructions: Use the Godot Gamestudio Supervisor to select roles. Dispatch maker tasks to Kimi's coder sub-agent, read-only reviews to explore, planning to plan, and QA commands to coder with explicit no-edit instructions.

interface.shortDescription: A supervised Godot production team with independent review.
interface.longDescription: Plan, build, review, and verify Godot milestones with dynamic specialists, evidence gates, and resumable state.
